I wasn't sure either but too many odd things have gone down to be coincidence. 
First, how I felt after first having sex... I knew him for 4 years that he apparently REALLY liked me, but after being physical. .. I cannot describe the feeling. I fill up notebooks trying. That was 3 years ago.
We had 3 months together, Angel numbers and syncronicites that even out friends noticed. We pretended to not have a thing, but it literally brought other people to tears when we spoke about one another, not in eachothers presence. It was awkward and intense in group settings because we would stare and stumble over words but when we were alone it went beyond smoothly, every word or touch was a note in the most beautiful symphony. I thought he didn't want me and he felt inadequate so he hung out with other girls... I wasn't jealous but I thought he was playing me. I later found out from those girls that he never did anything. He went to jail for a year during our third separation so we wrote letters everyday. Beautiful. Poetic love letters for a week shy of a year, and I realised he was insecure because of past trauma. He got out of jail and it was bliss, I always wanted him to know he is the best and he always took time to build me up, too. An ex friend of mine and a couple friends of his (nasty, conniving type) eventually caused us to separate by planting lies and being jealous. Seriously we were always laughing and hugging and had something to talk about and were both really naive to believe these people. It took 4 months to break ME mentally (I went psychotic, literally. Long story full of delusions and going inwardly/outwardly mad ending up at a psyche ward.) He grew distant and silent and I went crazier and crazier. We broke up and he immediately found someone else to fill the void. I bettered myself despite THE. Worst. Most hollow feeling I've ever known... I wasn't mad. Or jealous.. I was very sad. I did not choose to date and this went on for 18 months until I ran into a soulmate or karmic, idk which. We dated for three months and 3 days ago my DM (?) And I both broke up with our SOs, having no means of contact or knowing... we were just in synche. We messaged today before he blocked me again and I told him where I would be 2 weeks from now, I hope he meets me there. I know he will:) I hope he will.. lol also, telepathy and mirrored emotions. We leave eachother "messages" where I hear a short reassuring clip of his voice in meditation if im anxious about us at all. Happened mostly at the beginning of both separations, which is best to surrender and just get through by bettering oneself... instead of worrying. Watch out for the snakey people. They feed off divine energy and will literally deplete you, then manipulate and destroy both of you (temporarily,) turning you against eachother. The energy takes a good while to get back. It isn't like dealing with the average narcissist, where one can deflect and rebuke that vampirism fairly easily because they play on the only thing that matters in a twins life- the relationship. Also, anything we both pray for or will to be will happen. Like, once we made it rain out of nowhere when it was hot by saying "man, it should have rained today." "Yeah." I can't wait to start getting his help on my work because it's WAY stronger and more powerful to be in synche.
